_comment: The inputs a Tier 1 dry instantiation renders with (saas-bootstrap-engine BE5).
Acme is not a real product and never becomes one: this tree is placed into a
temp directory, asserted against, and deleted. The values are chosen to be
AWKWARD rather than tidy — a two-word product name, a hyphenated repo slug, a
multi-label domain — because a fixture that only uses values the templates
were written against proves the templates work on the values they were
Every key here is an input repo-blueprint.yaml declares. A key it does not
declare is a fixture that has drifted, and orun refuses it.
